name: Set Up Window for Painting
intent: Floor protection at window base, glass mask the panes, protect hardware (latches, locks, balances), mask the adjacent wall, protect the sill (spray only). Per-window setup is more involved than per-door setup because windows have glass that must not get painted on.
doctrine: Glass masking (60 SF/hr) is the slow part of window setup — taping glass cleanly without leaving residue requires careful work. Sill protection only fires for spray methods because brush work doesn't drip onto sills. Height modifier matters for tall windows on a ladder. V1b: pass_group_id: [null] gate on FLOOR_PROTECT only — its PS_PROTECT_SF.FLOOR_PERIMETER is room-level shared with trim/door_frame. Other window setup tasks (GLASS_MASK, HARDWARE_PROTECT, WALL_MASK, SILL_PROTECT) use window-specific ps_keys the shared module doesn't cover, so they stay per-window regardless of group membership.
